name: Morning briefing
what: Daily Telegram briefing: calendar, Big Three, weather, date-stamped.
why: Single daily orientation message so the day starts without digging.

name: Weekly Preview (v2)
what: Sun review->preview + Fri 3pm capture; pulls work meetings from a 'Work busy' calendar mirror for capacity math.
why: Forward-looking week setup; v2 made it staffing/capacity aware.

name: Conversation-aware reviews
what: Weekly (Sun 10:30) + monthly (last-Sun 09:30) read the session corpus + tasks -> styled HTML to Drive + Telegram.
why: Reviews that reflect what actually happened, not just task lists.

name: Incident log + outbound canary
what: Chronological outage tracker (incident_log.tsv); watchdog auto-appends; path-5 canary catches silent outbound drops.
why: Stop guessing at Daisy reliability; structural check caught a 3.5h silent outage.

name: Oura Ring integration
what: Daily sleep/recovery puller feeds the morning briefing (LAST NIGHT line) + monthly review trend.
why: Recovery context in the briefing; 2 config tweaks deferred for approval.

name: Award flight watcher (Phase 1)
what: seats.aero -> bookable-only (UR/MR) filter -> Daisy Telegram, twice daily.
why: Catch redeemable business-class award space without manual checking.

name: Claude usage tracker
what: Thursday ccusage -> Telegram summary of Claude Max usage.
why: Settled the keep-vs-downgrade $100 Max question (uses ~3.6x value).

name: Bridgetown practice-guide watcher
what: Wed baseline + Mon briefing line + Mon noon Telegram fallback; auto-follows series transitions.
why: Never miss the weekly church practice guide for community group.

name: GroupMe host-announcement check
what: API-backed weekly host-post detector; Sat 3pm Telegram nudge + Sun briefing escalation.
why: Make sure a community-group host is confirmed before Sunday.

name: Wednesday prep reminder
what: Tue 8pm nudge about packed Wed mornings (huddle + gym) with bedtime/wake math.
why: Protect against a rushed Wednesday morning.

name: Comms search + inbound sweep
what: daisy-msg-search (iMessage/SMS) + daisy-gmail-search + 7:05am com.daisy.inbound LaunchAgent Telegram sweep.
why: Consolidate incoming across channels so nothing slips between apps.

name: Daisy iMessage CLI
what: Send + scoped-read iMessage CLI; wired into host-check and reply-nudge flows.
why: Let Daisy act on iMessage, not just read awareness.

name: Daisy Gmail attachment CLI
what: Downloads Gmail attachments (gap the Gmail connector can't fill); reuses gmail-cleanup OAuth.
why: Pull attachments Daisy otherwise couldn't reach.

name: On Your Radar
what: Blind-spot job; folded into the weekly preview's 'on your radar' section.
why: Retired to avoid duplicate signal once the weekly preview covered it.

name: Monthly review (standalone)
what: Superseded by Conversation-aware reviews (above), which now produces the monthly. The old task-only job runs alongside through the ~Jun 22 trial, then off.
why: Forest-vs-trees companion to the weekly; the conversation-aware version replaced this standalone build.

name: /recon skill
what: Chief-of-Staff look-back over 30d of Claude sessions (local + Mini); verifies flags vs Todoist/Calendar/Gmail.
why: Backward-looking complement to On Your Radar; catch dropped loops.

name: /counsel skill
what: Mentor / Chief-of-Staff mode: questions + due diligence before recommendations.
why: A thinking-partner mode for live decisions and hard conversations.

name: /inbound skill
what: Cross-channel incoming sweep: name-resolved, triaged iMessage/SMS + email in one view.
why: One consolidated 'what came in' instead of app-by-app checking.

name: Gmail OAuth permanent fix
what: Consent screen published to Production; refresh token no longer expires on a timer.
why: Killed the recurring Gmail-auth break for good.

name: Zombie-poller fix
what: restart_daisy.sh pkill sweep + watchdog dup-detection for runaway duplicate bun pollers (409 token fight).
why: Fixed deaf-on-Telegram outages from duplicate listeners.

name: Date-staleness fix
what: Briefing/Big-Three prompts now stamp the real date after overnight restarts.
why: Daisy's 'today' was going stale after restart.

name: Daisy working memory + Drive backup
what: Local auto-loaded memory (!= Open Brain) + Drive output folder + nightly Drive backup of ~/daisy.
why: Persistent local context + offsite backup of Daisy's brain.

name: Telegram plugin monitor
what: Auto-detect + auto-restart when the Telegram MCP plugin goes offline (every 5 min).
why: Self-heal the most common Daisy outage class.

name: Daisy -> Mac Mini migration
what: Phase 0 checklist; moving Daisy off the MacBook (now cold backup) onto the always-on Mini.
why: Always-on host; stop the MacBook display-crash risk to Daisy uptime.

name: Tailnet private pages
what: Publish private web pages on the Mini via Tailscale Serve -> local port -> LaunchAgent.
why: Serve sensitive pages privately (macOS can't serve files directly).

name: GitHub Pages hosting
what: Deploy noindex, link-only static HTML to GitHub Pages for shareable, phone-viewable links.
why: Stable URLs for docs/checklists viewable on the phone.

name: London trip page deploy
what: Interactive HTML itinerary (History/Food toggle) for the Sep 2026 parents trip.
why: Shareable, phone-friendly trip plan.

name: Mini Day-1 checklist page deploy
what: Static setup checklist for the Mac Mini migration.
why: Track the migration steps from the phone.

name: X5 touch-up paint page deploy
what: Noindex link-only touch-up paint checklist.
why: Quick reference doc deploy.

name: /daisy-doctor skill
what: On-demand READ-ONLY outage diagnosis; mirrors watchdog precedence (E/A/B/D), reports root cause + cause code + exact fix; never auto-heals.
why: Instrument panel to the watchdog's autopilot; stop re-deriving Daisy's topology on every outage.

name: Daily Plan scheduler
what: Mon–Fri 7:20am Daisy proposes task placement from calendar+Todoist; on approval writes calendar blocks invited to work email; 5pm debrief learns durations.
why: Gives every slip-prone task a concrete "when"; re-flows around interruptions so a fire never leaves a blank day.

name: Work-calendar auto-accept
what: Power Automate flow auto-accepts Daisy's invites onto the KP work calendar; paired new-Outlook rule files the invite emails + marks them read.
why: Daily-plan blocks land on the work calendar with zero manual action each morning.

name: Briefing weather wrapper
what: Canonical allowlisted Open-Meteo fetch script so the morning briefing weather line stops triggering bash permission prompts.
why: Briefing was making Daniel approve a bash prompt most mornings whenever the ad-hoc weather fetch varied.

name: Injection busy gate (lib_send_prompt v2.1)
what: send_prompt now waits up to 7 min for Daisy to go idle (polls the esc-to-interrupt signal every 15s) before injecting; on timeout it aborts untouched and the caller fires the Telegram alert. All 13 scheduled scripts inherit it via the shared lib.
why: Scheduled scripts were Ctrl-C-ing Daisy mid-turn and pasting over live work (Telegram conversations, prior jobs); now they wait politely or alert instead of clobbering her.

name: /checkin skill (midday cockpit)
what: Midday daily-plan view in Claude Code: done/now/remaining blocks from calendar (strictly READ-ONLY) plus planned-vs-actual duration logging to a TSV ledger, synced to the Mini via two exact allowlisted scp commands.
why: Telegram is blocked at work, so the plan couldn't be checked or reality captured 9:30–5; calendar stays untouched so no outside tool visibly rearranges the work schedule.

name: Duration ledger learning loop
what: Canonical durations.tsv in ~/daisy/state; the 5pm debrief appends planned-vs-actual rows (skipping ones /checkin already logged) and the 7:20am proposal plans with measured averages once a task has 3+ rows.
why: The actual-vs-estimated signal evaporated after every debrief; now morning estimates improve from measured data instead of guessing from scratch.

name: Serial punts (Todoist hygiene)
what: Weekly preview gained a 🔁 section: punt_counts.py counts due-date punts from the Todoist activity log (28d, recurring excluded) + undated backlog.
why: Mechanical detector for avoidance-signature tasks that never come up in conversation — the reviews can't see what Daniel never mentions.

name: Self-healing morning retry window
what: Briefing (7:00-9:00) and daily plan (7:20-9:20) now fire every 15 min instead of once, made idempotent by per-day success stamps written only after send_prompt verifies delivery. The daily plan chains on the briefing stamp and defers rather than piling onto a wedged Daisy. Failure alarms collapse to a single window-close alert (was one per failed run).
why: On 6/12 the briefing prompt submitted at 7:00 but Daisy wedged mid-turn; the 7:20 daily plan then failed to submit and, with no retry, no plan went out. A failed early firing now self-heals on the next 15-min slot through ~9am.

name: Ghost-text wedge detector (shadow)
what: Log-only instrumentation (ghost_text_check.sh + com.daisy.ghostshadow, every 5 min) that snapshots Daisy's input box each tick: detects the dim (SGR \e[2m) Prompt-Suggestions ghost line, distinguishes it from real buffered input, and tracks how long the same line stays parked, alongside spinner/pending/outbound-canary state. No alerts, no restart, kept out of watchdog.sh; Phase 2 promotes the confirmed signature to alert-only.
why: The ghost-text wedge (cause C) was the only failure class with zero automated monitoring and had to be hand-logged; shadow-first learns the real swallow signature before alerting, avoiding Path 3's 9 false restarts.

name: Recon memo (Chief of Staff)
what: Daily backward-looking blind-spot scan: recon_memo.sh on the Mini (daily ~9:40 AM, com.daniel.recon-memo) reads ~30d of sessions + calendar/Todoist/Gmail and writes a memo; a SessionStart hook pulls it to the laptop; the /memo skill displays it and acts on each item; the statusline shows a 🧭 memo-unread indicator so it's visible on the surface, not just injected as context.
why: The proactive half of the Chief-of-Staff vision (on-demand half = /counsel + /recon). Lives on the Claude Code surface because Telegram is blocked at work; daily + backward-looking, so it complements the weekly/forward preview instead of duplicating it.

name: Review jobs see completed tasks
what: New daisy-todoist.sh --completed mode + fmt_completed.py inject COMPLETED Todoist tasks as text into the recon memo, weekly, and monthly jobs; added Rule A (completed = win) and Rule B (calendar event = neutral). Dropped the dead Todoist MCP path on the Mini.
why: The look-back jobs only saw OPEN tasks, so finished work (e.g. a closed KZS controlled-substance variance) got false-flagged as drift; now a completed task reads as a win, not a slip.

name: GroupMe in the inbound sweep
what: New read-only daisy-groupme-search CLI pulls both community-group channels via the GroupMe API (name-resolved, flags @mentions + own posts, HTTP-only so it survives a wedged chat.db); wired into the 7:05am sweep and the /inbound skill on both machines.
why: Community-group announcements and @mentions lived in a channel the inbound sweep couldn't see; now they're triaged alongside iMessage + email instead of being missed.

name: Exercise block in weekly review; old jobs retired
what: Ported the Oura 4x/week workout count into the conversation-aware weekly review (weekly-only, perl-timeout bounded). With the last gap closed, retired the redundant old task-only weekly (5pm) and monthly (9am) jobs (plists renamed .disabled-superseded).
why: The new conversation-aware reviews now fully supersede the old task-only pair, so a duplicate review is gone and the exercise/Oura trend lives in the weekly.

name: One-command changelog publish (publish.sh)
what: ~/daisy-changelog/publish.sh rebuilds both pages, commits, and pushes in a single allowlisted command, auto-resolving the Mini's hourly incident-sync rebase race on the generated index.html.
why: Updating the shipped log / drawing board used to cost a string of approval prompts; now it's one command, collapsing the friction.

name: Weekend temp-check nudge
what: com.daisy.tempcheck fires Sat+Sun 2pm Pacific and pushes a static Telegram nudge (via send_telegram.sh) to check Keizer Station ambient temp, which has no over-threshold alert. Auto-expires 2026-07-20: the script no-ops and unloads its own agent. Daniel keeps an independent phone alarm as backup.
why: Keizer Station ambient temp can run hot with no automated threshold alert; a weekend reminder closes the gap. Static push (not tmux injection) so it cannot be blocked by the busy gate or knock the poller offline; one-month trial that cleans itself up.

name: Watchdog outbound path is now loop-safe
what: Rebuilt the watchdog's outbound-drop detection after a self-sustaining restart loop made a HEALTHY Daisy unusable ~30 min (restart killed her mid-reply → canary read the unsent reply as a drop → restart again). Adds: a 120s grace in outbound_check.py (an in-progress reply is no longer called a drop); a MID-TURN GUARD (new is_processing check — never restart while she is actively working; a >10min same-message hang escalates instead of auto-killing); SAME-INBOUND two-tick confirmation (rapid new messages no longer false-confirm); and a per-incident CIRCUIT BREAKER (exactly one outbound restart, then escalate until a healthy tick — no runaway). Removed the invalid post-restart recheck. Codex-reviewed twice (design + concrete diff; caught 2 defects, fixed pre-deploy). Synthetic-transcript tests pass; real silent-drop detection preserved.
why: The self-healing watchdog was doing the OPPOSITE of its job — breaking Daisy while she was working. This breaks the feedback loop while keeping the 6/6 real silent-drop auto-heal.
